title: The pieces meet at (2, 1) when k = 0
caption: At x = 2 the right piece gives 2² − 3 = 1 and the left piece gives 2k + 1; they agree when k = 0, and the graph has no jump.
alt: A horizontal line y = 1 for x below 2 joined at (2, 1) to the curve y = x squared minus 3 for x from 2 upwards.
description: For x ≥ 2 the curve is x² − 3, which is 1 at x = 2.
For x < 2 the line is kx + 1, which is 2k + 1 at x = 2.
Setting 2k + 1 = 1 gives k = 0: the pieces join at (2, 1).

checks.name: the left piece kx + 1 with k = 0 gives 1 at x = 2
the right piece gives 4 − 3 = 1 at x = 2
